name: Ishiyama Michiko
source: A girl who was the [url=/c83707]protagonist's[/url] classmate before he enrolled into Toaru Girls Academy.  She wanted to change herself, so after graduation she became a sports club instructor. The before and after transformation made her near unrecognizable. The protagonist is unable to recognize her as his old classmate.
